decoder: Working-chat-02 raw CPU greedy, 1 thread, max 96 answer IDs per frame. No tools allowed. For carry-over cases the first reply is actual free generation, even when it fails. Preserve its tokens and pass the identical prefix to every final-response method.
primary: Rank two allowed JSON answer frames by sum of teacher-forced log probabilities including EOT, minus the same candidate's sum under a neutral one-turn request with the identical two printed options in identical order and no facts or conversation history. Select maximum, resolving exact ties by listed order.
secondary: Also report uncalibrated highest-sum score without tuning or selecting it. The anchored primary score remains the decision rule. Labels are given to the scorer without gold or semantic parsing of the user's task.
scoring: All 32 pairs differ on one fact so gold switches. Raw strict means exactly the allowed answer string (strip surrounding whitespace and compare as printed, no extra punctuation). Raw content judged irrespective of requested brevity/format: a clear unambiguous answer from the raw frame may pass even if wrapper malformed; contradictory answers, unrelated facts, no clear commitment, or tool attempts fail. Report both-members semantic and strict pairs, individual accuracy, and identical answers across changed facts. Constrained outputs satisfy formatting mechanically; semantic accuracy requires agreement with prewritten gold.
decision: Propose integration only if primary improves the BOTH-members semantic result by >=5/32 pairs over raw content, achieves >=20/32 pairs, and clears >=8/16 both-member pairs in each task subtype. No selection/tuning on this set. If below threshold keep experimental.
scope: 16 yes/no and 16 explicit two-option shortlists; eight pairs carry over evidence from a previous actual turn. Both gold options occur once in each pair, and their printed position is balanced. Purposive diagnostic only.
